method: AI-assisted reading of official sources; no independent human review or live application-portal check
selection: Refresh two older pilot records with unresolved cohort, fee or deadline fields. This is a bounded maintenance batch, not an all-programme completeness claim.

cuhk.access: Graduate School pages read with the research tool. Department application/FAQ pages failed there but both returned HTTP 200 through direct read-only HTTPS retrieval; their relevant body text was inspected, not just search snippets.

cohort.decision: Use the explicitly dated September 2027 body and matching central deadlines; retain the stale-heading discrepancy for confirmation. Do not infer an exact term-start day.

dates.openingBasis: Central commencement date excludes PCLL, not Anthropology; department also states September 2026.
dates.caution: Rolling assessment may fill places early. After 31 December consideration depends on places; final listed round is not a guaranteed open portal. Do not import neighbouring MPhil/PhD dates.

fees.approval: Department application marks tuition as awaiting approval; FAQ describes figures as tentative.
fees.decision: Import provisional full-time annual tuition with caveats. Keep part-time numeric tuition null because the charging basis conflicts; do not select a figure or calculate a two-year total. Keep the application fee separate.

requirements.academicAlternatives: Recognised bachelor degree normally at least second-class honours or average B, or accepted equivalent qualification; university judgement, not a numeric GPA conversion.
requirements.homeEditionAndIeltsOnline: Accepted by the current general English page; programme-specific acceptance/evidence remains subject to university review.
requirements.validity: TOEFL/IELTS two years from test; GMAT five years. Applicable evidence, anchor and alternative qualifications remain manual.
requirements.documents: One-page purpose statement; two references; transcript/grading and degree evidence; English proof where needed; applicable verification documents. Not collected by this website.
requirements.notImported: No numeric undergraduate GPA, guaranteed waiver, MPhil subject restriction, research scholarship, exchange-rate conversion or housing estimate.

suss.access: Research-tool page text available. Direct local download/page requests hit a security block and were not bypassed. PDF screenshots did not yield inspectable images; no local PDF was created. Fee PDF was read as extracted text only, not visually verified.

intake.decision: Do not attach the 16 October 2026 to 15 April 2027 windows of other featured programmes to MMGT. No exact MMGT cohort/window was established.

pathways.regular: Programme page limits this pathway to Singapore citizens/PRs; up to 20 CU per semester.
pathways.accelerated: Programme page admits international applicants and eligible citizens/PRs not employed full-time; suitability assessed at interview; up to 30 CU per semester.
pathways.decision: Keep the existing grouped option unresolved, with an explicit mandatory manual condition. No residence/status inference or new route is created.

durationConflict.decision: Replace the previously unqualified duration with a conflict warning; do not choose one duration or equate regular/accelerated with part-/full-time modes.

fees.tableUpdated: October 2026; text states fees accurate as of 16 October 2026
fees.textCautions: Separate SSG-subsidy and residence columns; fees exclude GST and extra charges and may be revised. Column mapping not visually verified.
fees.depositBasis: General admissions page: includes prevailing GST and offsets the first-semester course bill; not extra tuition.
fees.decision: Keep tuition null: exact cohort, applicant category, subsidy applicability and table layout were not fully verified. Do not invent a universal price, aid deduction or total cost.

requirements.degree: Recognised undergraduate degree or accepted equivalent; alternative qualifications considered individually with relevant experience.
requirements.unsupportedAlternatives: Paper TOEFL 580, PTE 58, C1 180, MUET band 4; not converted into an iBT or updated TOEFL score.
requirements.validity: Application-time two-year score window for the listed non-MUET tests, five years for MUET; evidence/waiver checked manually.
requirements.waiver: Official medium-of-instruction letter needed when claiming an English-taught degree from a non-English-medium institution; not an automatic waiver.
requirements.programmeSpecific: Shortlisted interview, alternative-qualification merit review and pathway suitability. Volunteering is advantageous, not mandatory years of work. GMAT/GRE not required.
requirements.decision: No undergraduate GPA minimum, mandatory experience-year threshold, universal field whitelist or specific study mode is invented. Certificate/diploma and specialisation requirements are not silently substituted.
